 Сдается нежилое помещение в составе 5 комнат общей площадью 110 кв.м. в центре города. Первый этаж исторического архитектурного здания, три самостоятельных входа на две центральные улицы, три отдельных санузла. Помещение капитально отремонтировано. EN: 
Prime 5-room commercial space in historic Baku building – 110 square metres

Discover unparalleled potential in this exceptional non-residential space, ideally located at 71 Vidadi Street, in the heart of Baku. Offering 110 m² of meticulously renovated space, this property combines historic charm with modern functionality.

Key Features:

• Prime Location: Situated on the first floor of a distinguished historical architectural building, this property benefits from high visibility and foot traffic, perfect for any business venture.

• Multiple Entrances: Three independent entrances provide direct access to two of Baku’s central streets, enhancing customer accessibility and business exposure.

• Fully Renovated: 
The space boasts a fresh, contemporary look while retaining its classic architectural details.

• Customizable Layout: With five spacious rooms, this property offers flexibility for a variety of business setups.

• Modern Amenities: Enjoy a separate heating system, continuous water and electricity supply, and three bathrooms, ensuring comfort and convenience for both staff and customers.
